features.titleHtml:
Lungisela hi nkarhi wo vutlula.
Humbisa hi ku tshembeka ku tlula.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker yi cinca ntirho lowu fambelanaka emaheleni ya ku humbisaka app ku va workflow yo vonakala leyi hlayiseke.

cards.title: Nghenisa swikombo swa app ya wena.
cards.body: Nghenisa screenshot, veka ta hlayiseka eka layout ya device, naswona lulamisa xana xa App Store hi maminyeti.

cards.title: Dizayina hi nkarhi kun'we.
cards.body: Sebentisa mit AVC, layout, swiseti swa device, mufuna wa mavutiso, na mimunyi eka ripapi rin'wana na rin'wana kambe u tshamela ku endla leswaku xivandla xin'wana na xin'wana xi va xi ri xo hlawuleka.

cards.title: Hambisana na xikombo xin'wana na xin'wana.
cards.body: Lungiselela swilo swa iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, na feature graphics eka projekto yin'we.

cards.title: Export-a package leyi lungiseke ku humbiswa.
cards.body: Endla swifaniso swo voneka kahle (high-resolution), lulamisa mafayela ya lexiyondlwana, naswona hlanganisa App Store metadata leyi hundzuluxiweke eka archive yin'we leyi hlayiseke.

ollama.title: Tutorial ya ku seta Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Hlanganisa Screenshot (App) Maker eka Ollama instance ya wena leswaku u hundzuluxa na ku endla teksi hi AI.
requirements: Mac, Windows PC, kumbe xishandzisi xa Linux xo khomisa Ollama
Ollama yi setiwile naswona yi khomeka
iPhone/iPad ya wena eka network yin'wana na xishandzisi xa Ollama (yi tsembiwa)
steps: Instala Ollama: download-a na ku instala Ollama eka OS ya wena.
Sungula Ollama: rhunza ollama serve (kumbe pfula app ya Ollama eka macOS).
Kha model: rhunza ollama pull llama3.2 (kumbe model leyi u yi lavaka).
Titivisa ukuri swi hlaya: rhunza ollama run llama3.2 kutani tlola prompt.
Vuva adiresi ya server: tsala LAN IP ya khomputa ya wena (xikombiso 192.168.0.10).
Yi tirhisa eka app: eka settings ta Screenshot (App) Maker, veka Host kuva http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: Loko app yi ingeta ku connect-a, titivisa ukuri foni na khomputa ya wena swi le xitirhisiwa xa Wi‑Fi xin'we.
Titivisa ukuri port 11434 yi pfumelelwa hi firewall ya wena.
Loko u lava ku tirhisa remote server (home PC, VPS), u fanele ku pfula port hi ndlela leyi hlayisekileke (ku khutsatswiwa VPN).
ollama.ctaBody: Vutela eka app, tlola connection, kutani sungula hi ririmi rin'we.

privacy.title: Polisi ya Xichandzeni
privacy.intro: Polisi leyi ya Xichandzeni yi hlamusela howu Screenshot (App) Maker ("app") yi fambisaka vutivi bya xitsarixi.
summary: A ku na ti-account. A ku na analytics. A ku na ku landzelela.
Mafayela na ku lulamisa ka wena swi sala eka xitirhisiwa xa wena loko u nga nketa ku xandza na server ya wena ya Ollama.
Loko u tirhisa Ollama, titekisi ti rhumiwa ntsena eka xiyandziro xa server lexi u xi setelele.

sections.title: Ku hlangela vutivi
body: App leyi a yi hlangeli, yi hlayi, kumbe yi rhuma vutivi bya munhu eka ti-server ta hina.
Sikrinishoti, temipulati na swifaniso swo humisiwa swi endliwa naswona swi hlayisiwa eka xitirhisi xa wena.

sections.title: Ku akanyeta Mafayila na Swifaniso
body: App yi nga kombela ku akanyeta app ya Mafayila kumbe layibrari ya swifaniso swa wena ku tisa sikrinishoti.
Swifaniso swo tisiwa swi endliwa eka xitirhisi naswona a swi hlayisiwi hi xivandla.

sections.title: Ku hundzuluxa ka AI (Ollama)
body: Loko u enabla ku endla tekisi kumbe ku hundzuluxa ka AI, App yi nga rhuma tekisi eka sevura ya Ollama leyi u yi lulamisaka (hi xikombiso, khomputa ya wena).
Hi nga fambisiyi kumbe hi nga tsemii trafik ya wena ya Ollama, naswona App a yi hlayisi tekisi leyi endliwe hi AI.

sections.title: Tirhiselo ta Vanyikazi
body: App a yi tirhisi analytics ta vanyikazi, SDKs ta xitshungulo kumbe tikonolodzhi ta ku landzekisa.

sections.title: Ku cinca
body: Hi nga hlayisa Polisi ya Xivandlu leyi nkarhi na nkarhi. Swi cincaka swi ta voneka eka pephani leyi.

sections.title: Xikambelo
body: Loko u ri na swivutiso hi Polisi leyi ya Xivumelelo xa Xiyimo, rhuluxana na hina hi adirese ya imeyile lexi nyikiweke eka xilistu xa App Store.
